name: axis-migrate
description: Moves a legacy, GUI-based desktop GIS project (QGIS projects and models, ArcPy/PyQGIS scripts, notebooks, Excel, hand edits) into a reproducible Python codebase and onto your cloud platform (Databricks today), verifying every step against the legacy run's own intermediates and final outputs and reporting one status computed from evidence, never claimed by the agent.

interface.longDescription: Moves a legacy desktop GIS project into a reproducible Python codebase and a cloud job: discover a read-only legacy folder, map and investigate it, interview, plan, build step by step, run under a read ledger, compare every step against the legacy intermediates and finals, seal the evidence and compute the status with ladder.py. Start with $axis-migrate:start; trust the plugin's hooks once in /hooks (CODEX.md).
defaultPrompt: Migrate the legacy GIS folder ./legacy with $axis-migrate:start
